objective: Test whether trained-CQ3 error is separable at tensor rather than whole-layer granularity by admitting every individual MLP tensor at or below the already-qualified v67 calibration-NMSE threshold while retaining Q4 only for the sensitive tensor modes.

rationale.v67_observation: The 32-layer triplet model was functional at 8/20 CUTE but discarded every gate and up tensor whenever the same layer contained one sensitive projection.
rationale.v68_observation: The 48-layer triplet model failed the frozen screen at 6/20. At its calibration boundary, 15 of the 16 layer-limiting tensors were ffn_down and one was ffn_gate, showing strong role and tensor anisotropy.
rationale.testable_hypothesis: The failure is driven by a sparse set of high-error tensor modes rather than by the total CQ3 tensor count. Independently admitting only tensors no worse than the functional v67 threshold should retain function at nearly the v68 storage footprint.
rationale.disconfirming_result: France failure or fewer than 7 of 20 frozen CUTE items is evidence against separability at this scalar tensor-NMSE threshold.
rationale.benchmark_adaptivity: The threshold was qualified by prior CUTE screening, so CUTE is development evidence from v69 onward. It cannot serve as independent final quality evidence.

selection.score: selected_calibration_nmse of each independently trained gate, up, or down CQ3 tensor
selection.ranking_order: ascending score then lexicographic GGUF tensor name
selection.threshold_provenance: maximum layer score admitted by the preregistered functional v67 model

candidate.attention: unchanged Q4 control bytes; no AFF3
candidate.publish_rule: write only to .partial until exact byte scope, ranking, selection, and trained-payload authentication pass

decision.if_pass: freeze this candidate and run held-out WikiText, MATH, code, and MMLU gates before paired throughput
decision.if_fail: reject scalar tensor-NMSE separability and test a lower or role-conditioned calibration rule without timing the failed candidate

claim_boundary: A pass establishes only a development-screen candidate for a tensor-separable trained-CQ3 hybrid. CUTE is adaptive evidence and cannot establish held-out capability, perplexity, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
